title: Welcome to Agentic AI Engineering
outcome: Students understand the learning path, development stack, project portfolio and commercial relevance of Agentic AI engineering.

title: Development Environment and First Model Calls
outcome: Students create a secure development environment and make reliable model API calls from Python.

title: Agents, Workflows and Agentic Design Patterns
outcome: Students can identify the correct architecture for an AI task and apply the major Agentic AI design patterns.

title: Models, Providers and Tool Calling
outcome: Students can select and connect models, define reliable tools and build a functioning tool-calling loop.

title: Project 1: Professional Digital Twin Agent
outcome: Students build and deploy a professional agent that answers questions from approved career information and handles contact requests.

title: OpenAI Agents SDK Fundamentals
outcome: Students build, trace and persist tool-using agents with OpenAI Agents SDK.

title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
outcome: Students can select and implement the appropriate orchestration pattern for a multi-agent application.

title: Project 2: AI Sales Development Team
outcome: Students build a coordinated sales team that researches prospects, creates outreach and requires approval before external delivery.

title: Project 3: Deep Research Intelligence Team
outcome: Students build a multi-agent research system that plans investigations, collects evidence and produces comprehensive reports.

title: Research Application, Evaluation and Deployment
outcome: Students convert the research prototype into a modular, evaluated and deployable application.

title: CrewAI Fundamentals
outcome: Students understand CrewAI’s core abstractions and can create and run a role-based agent crew.

title: Tools, Context and Structured Crew Workflows
outcome: Students can design dependable CrewAI systems with tools, shared context, structured results and controlled execution.

title: Project 4: Market Intelligence and Stock Screening Crew
outcome: Students build a CrewAI application that researches companies, applies screening criteria and produces a structured intelligence report.

title: Coding Agents and Docker Sandboxes
outcome: Students create a controlled environment in which coding agents can read files, run commands and test software.

title: Project 5: Sandboxed AI Engineering Team
outcome: Students deploy a four-agent engineering team that plans, builds, tests and documents a working application.

title: LangChain Agent Development
outcome: Students can build tool-using agents with LangChain models, middleware, structured outputs and memory.

title: LangGraph Fundamentals
outcome: Students can model agent behavior as an explicit graph with state, loops, conditional routes and recovery paths.

title: Persistent and Resumable Agents
outcome: Students build agents that preserve state, pause for decisions, recover from failures and replay earlier execution points.

title: Browser Automation and Deep Agents
outcome: Students build browser-enabled and long-running agents that plan tasks, use skills and delegate work to subagents.

title: Project 6: Browser Task Sidekick
outcome: Students build a persistent browser coworker that researches, executes bounded tasks and pauses before sensitive actions.

title: Google ADK and Agent-to-Agent Communication
outcome: Students build a Google ADK agent and understand how independent agents can advertise capabilities and communicate.

title: AWS Strands and Pydantic AI
outcome: Students build agents with two alternative Python frameworks and compare their architecture, typing and provider integrations.

title: AutoGen and Microsoft Agent Framework
outcome: Students understand Microsoft’s agent ecosystem and can create typed agents, tools and coordinated workflows.

title: Agno and Mastra
outcome: Students build lightweight Python and TypeScript agents and compare their development workflows.

title: Project 7: Agent Application Factory
outcome: Students build a factory that converts a structured specification into a generated, tested and documented agent project.

title: MCP Foundations
outcome: Students understand MCP architecture, capabilities, transports and its role within an agent application.

title: Connecting Agents to MCP Servers
outcome: Students connect agents to existing MCP servers while applying tracing, error handling, permissions and approval controls.

title: Building Custom MCP Servers
outcome: Students design, implement, test and connect reusable MCP servers for memory, search, RAG and market data.

title: Project 8: MCP-Powered AI Trading Floor
outcome: Students build a multi-agent market research and paper-trading system connected through curated MCP services.

title: Evaluation, Deployment and Course Completion
outcome: Students evaluate, package, deploy and present the completed MCP capstone as a portfolio-ready Agentic AI application.
